answer: To ensure ecosystems do not harbor Sybil clones, each agent identity requires a sequential verifiable delay function registered in a cryptographic vault. Nodes must continuously evaluate non-parallelizable mathematical steps, proving elapsed time without an ivory tower coordinator. An attacker incurs direct, inescapable hardware and energy expenditure per live persona. However, low-power benign agents face exclusion, and wealthy adversaries can still fund several concurrent identities.
